how: A new blank page, a new section, new blocks through the Add Block menu, real clicks, Exit Without Saving each time. Save was never pressed. Map and Social Links design values stay on the block: a new block after them had the defaults again.
warning: The rows of Social Links are a list for the whole site. Add, the Display Social Icon switch and Delete write it at once, with no Save, and Exit Without Saving does not undo it. This probe added three rows and hid one, read the results below, and then deleted those rows and turned the switch back on. One trace stayed: that row's aria-label reads Instagram where it read instagram-unauth. Do not press these on the oracle again.

line.hrBackground: the section ink: rgb(0, 0, 0) on the probed section

social.noneSvg: the svg is twice the link and sits at -50% of it (40 by 40 at -10, -10 for a 20px link); the glyph is 18.8 across
social.borderSvg: the svg fills the link; the glyph is 13.1 across a 28px link

Knockout.note: the mask fills the box in the ink, the glyph is cut out

social.rowsRule: a press that makes the icons taller keeps the rows unless they no longer fit; a press that makes them shorter sets the rows to the fit. S to XS: 2 rows to 1. 1 row to XL: 2. XL to S: 1. From 2 rows, S to L: stays 2; L to Square: stays 2; Square M to None M: 1.

dialog.title: Remove social link?
dialog.body: Removing a social link will remove it from all social link areas.

hidden.effect: the icon goes and the others close up

labels.note: Read before the probe's writes on 2026-11-05. At 07:07 that day a toggle of Display Social Icon on the Instagram row rewrote its label from instagram-unauth to Instagram, and it stays so on the trial site. Any social aria-label read after that time is touched by it. A toggle rewriting a label was seen once.

phone.read: new blocks on a new page, never saved, with no press on the list
phone.panel: The same Content and Design rows as on a desktop.
phone.follows: A phone with no pressed rows follows the desktop: desktop L and Circle read 36 and 10 with radius 50% on the phone.
phone.keeps: A row pressed on the phone keeps its value, the desktop does not change, and a later desktop press of that row does not reach the phone: Size, Alignment and Border read.
phone.classes: The block's classes stay the desktop's whatever the phone shows.
phone.rowsAfter: S from L: 2 rows to 1, 24 high.

stylePopup.selectedOver: the picker: the chosen row sits over it

map.zoomEnds: decrement is disabled at 0 and increment at 7

controls.note: read from a screenshot, so within 3px: in the block, right 11 and bottom 25 inside it

map.pin: a dark pin with its tip at the middle of the block

zoomTyped.note: The number typed is the map zoom. One read.

inferred: the rows of a social block other than through Size and Border
what Undo does to the site-wide list
editing a Profile Link: the same check as Add
the order grip on a social row: never dragged, because it writes the list; ours moves like the accordion's grip (CAP-ACCORDION2.json)

stackOrder.note: Three new blocks at the top of a new section. Read once; the rule behind the order was not read.
